notices.title: ML Aim updated
notices.text:
ML Aim has been updated, so you need to record a new Dataset and retrain. Sorry for the inconvenience. It will give you better results.

Thank you for understanding.

notices.title: VERSION 2.1.8 CHANGELOGS
notices.text:
- Bugfix
- Hitsounds (227 available sounds. ex: skeet, minecraft, rust_headshot, neverlose, cod, quake)
- UI Reorganized
- ML Aim reworked and improved
- ML Aim .vxmodels can be exported/imported. You can share mouse models to other users
- verux configs .vxprofiles can be exported/imported. You can share verux.apb configs to other users
